company.name: Presto
company.shortDescription: Presto is a software company that provides AI and automation solutions to the restaurant industry.
company.description: Presto overlays next-gen digital solutions onto the physical world. Presto’s enterprise-grade voice, vision, and touch technologies help hospitality businesses thrive while delighting guests. With over 250,000 systems shipped, Presto is one of the largest labor automation technology providers in the industry. Founded at M.I.T. in 2008, Presto is headquartered in Silicon Valley, Calif. with customers including many of the top 20 restaurant chains in the U.S.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $10,000,000, or 4.91% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-21).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
